note: `kind` is one of `community` and `kudos`; a badge is never a group kind.
`limit` is at most 200; a larger page is refused, not clamped silently.
`cursor` is an opaque continuation token, never an offset.
Unknown top-level payload member — additionalProperties: false catches `entryId`; another member's badges are vtc/badges/wall/show, never a filter here.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Every item carries `myCount` and `myState`: the caller's own standing is what distinguishes this listing from a catalogue.
